description: One More Night is the second offering from Ivy Sole's forthcoming album, candid. Featuring a stellar sixteen from Topaz Jones, the Montclair mack himself, the two pine for one more evening of passion with a person they shouldn't be giving the time of day (or night, for that matter). The joint features not only their songwriting prowess, but also their adeptness at bridging R&B and hip hop production, showcasing the broad, talented strokes of both of hip hop's heirs.
credits:
written, performed and produced by ivy sole and topaz jones.
mixed by jerry lang ii + mastered by dave kutch.
